name: Spire Adjacent: The Rennick-Osei Hour
description: A long-running Axiom-sponsored lifestyle and interview program hosted by the impeccably presented Cassia Rennick-Osei, a Tier 4 personality with curated warmth and a talent for making corporate policy sound like personal philosophy. Each episode features an 'ascent story' — a Tier 2 or 3 individual who made it into Tier 4 through Axiom-affiliated programs — alongside aspirational product integrations and soft-focus Spire lifestyle segments. The show has aired continuously since 2189, making it one of the longest-running programs in Meridian 88.
cultural_impact: Cassia Rennick-Osei became a cultural shorthand for aspirational corporate compliance; 'very Rennick-Osei' is Shelf slang for someone performing contentment they don't feel.
story_hooks: An ascent story participant from the 2207 season reaches out to an investigator — they were never actually promoted; they were a paid actor, and they've since been told to stay quiet.
Cassia Rennick-Osei has not appeared on camera in four months; a body double is hosting under heavy filter augmentation, and the production team is refusing all press inquiries.
The show's archived back-catalog, when analyzed across 30 years, reveals a consistent pattern: every episode featuring Shelf-adjacent content aired within a week of a major Axiom labor dispute.
